name: Maud Bregeon
bio: Maud Bregeon, born 11 February 1991 in Poitiers, is a French politician of Renaissance and a nuclear engineer by training. A graduate of the Ecole polytechnique de l'universite de Nantes (Polytech Nantes), she worked at the French electricity company EDF from 2014 to 2022, specialising in nuclear-plant contracts and crisis/accident situations, before being elected deputy for the 13th constituency of Hauts-de-Seine in 2022. A staunch advocate of nuclear power, she was rapporteure of the 2023 nuclear acceleration law. She served as spokesperson of the Government in the Barnier government (September-December 2024) and again from October 2025 in the Lecornu government. Following the 26 February 2026 reshuffle she was appointed Minister-Delegate to the Prime Minister, Government spokesperson, in charge of Energy.
